{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication worked
print(f'After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} patients')
print(f'Original rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Patients with multiple rows in original: {len(df[df.duplicated(subset="patient_id", keep=False)])}')

# Check that we have one row per patient
print(f'Unique patient_ids after dedup: {df_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Now correct assay_batch B: divide biomarker_final by 10
# Create a copy to avoid modifying original
df_final = df_dedup.copy()
df_final.loc[df_final['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Verify the correction
print(f'biomarker_final mean (batch A): {df_final[df_final["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'biomarker_final mean (batch B): {df_final[df_final["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')

# Compute the final mean across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_final['biomarker_final'].mean()
print(f'Final mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}')"}
